roe: Nobody may learn we were there. Avoid every aircraft and ground unit you can. Do not fire unless your own aircraft is in danger, and do not leave anything behind that could be traced to us.
This flight does not officially exist. Stay unseen, keep clear of populated areas and only use your weapons on the objectives. If you are detected, break off and come home.
We are not at war. Get in and out without being seen. Weapons are for the assigned targets and for self-defence only.
Hostilities are limited. You may engage anything that threatens you or your objectives, but keep clear of civilian areas and do not cross into neutral airspace.
We are in a limited conflict. Enemy military targets may be engaged if they get in the way. Avoid civilian casualties at all costs.
The situation is tense but not open war. Defend yourself and hit the assigned targets; leave everything else alone.
We are at war. Every enemy military target is fair game.
Full hostilities. Engage the enemy wherever you find them, but stay clear of civilian targets.
Open war. Use your weapons as you see fit against enemy forces.
